text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Ayabe-senpai, I heard it's your 
birthday today. Happy birthday.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...I'm just not used to it. Being the 
center of attention, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the celebration, but... 
there's a moment where all the excitement 
suddenly fades...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...I think I know that feeling. Like an 
overwhelming urge to just start 
running..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes. I feel like I have to run. 
Especially today... I must run."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
In that case, would you like me to show 
you the course I usually run on?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
There's barely any cars or people, it's so 
quiet... It feels great to run here. I bet 
you'd find it easy to run here too, 
Ayabe-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Are you sure? Telling them, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Having time to face your running 
alone is important.
